errors.description: Expected revision/version does not match current state.
Artifact content hash does not match the expected canonical hash.
Operation rejected because the revision is locked.
Repeated idempotency key used with a different normalized request.
Episode state transition is not allowed.
Disallowed command because approval is required; normal waiting is represented in the run resource.
Required runtime capability is unavailable; no silent fallback.

idempotency_rule: All mutating endpoints require an idempotency key and expected revision/version where applicable. A repeated key with the same normalized request returns the original result; a different request returns IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.
